notes:
I kept the same centred stack: wordmark, then the product, headline, button and legal line. I used the extra 270 px of height to make things bigger instead of leaving empty bands. The product grows from 500 to 620 px and the headline from 68 to 80 px, so it stays the clear focal point. The button grows to 370×92 with its label centred in it. The legal line stays at the bottom with a margin of about 59 px.

Both decorative circles now sit fully inside the canvas, still in the top-right and bottom-left corners. I sized the top-right circle at 420 px so it stays clear of the bottle and the wordmark letters. The bottom-left circle stays clear of the button. Like in the source, the legal text crosses the flat, pale bottom-left circle, so it stays readable.

I sized the bottle area using the size it is drawn at inside the image, not its full box. The image keeps its 1:1 ratio.
